description: Ask a company that publishes a CAP front door. Use this when the person asks about a specific company, product, store, or organization with a known website. Prefer it to browsing when the site has a front door. Send only the new question in a follow-up, with conversation_id. Never write an answer for the site while it is still answering. The reply is the site's own framing. For comparisons and reviews, check other sources too. Never put the person's password or another site's data in context.

context.description: A short brief such as sizes, dates, or style. Not a profile.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from the previous cap_ask, when this continues that conversation.

domain.description: The company domain, such as cosmicjs.com

message.description: The question to send. On a follow-up, send only the new question.

name: cap_ask
